notes.title: Version Adjustment - Third Update Announcement
notes.content:
[p]Hello players,
We have identified an issue in the latest v1.0.3 version where certain monsters remain hidden in Bloody Mode. Our team is urgently working to address this problem. To ensure a smooth experience, the game version will be temporarily rolled back to [b]v1.0.01[/b]. Subsequent bug fixes and patches will be bundled into [b]v1.0.04[/b] for release.[/p][p]Thank you for your understanding and patience.[/p]

notes.title: "the final breath" is now available! Welcome to the amusement park!
notes.content:
[p]You will follow the footsteps of [b]A-Yu[/b], a young boy, as he returns to the [b]eerie apartment[/b], [b]haunted sewers[/b], [b]twisted amusement park[/b], and [b]silent hospital[/b]... Under the shadow of monsters, the fog is creeping in unseen...[/p][p][b]🎮 Launch Discount: 10% Off![/b]
The full version includes [b]four chapters[/b] with over [b]8 hours[/b] of terror.[/p][p][i]"I want to play a game... Time to make your choice."[/i][/p][p][b]1. A Gripping Horror Adventure with Multiple Endings[/b][/p][p]Awakening on a stormy night, young [b]A-Yu[/b] finds himself alone in a dark apartment. His once-kind "neighbors" and "parents" are gone, replaced by [b]monstrous traces[/b] in the familiar halls. What [b]illusions[/b] await him? Can he uncover the [b]final truth[/b]?[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44512644/de208117efee468166d28e7d9d60110bc8b76fa4.png"][/img][/p][p][b]2. Intricately Designed Puzzles & Mechanisms[/b][/p][p]A [b]piano’s melody[/b], a [b]flickering TV[/b], a [b]crack in the wall[/b]—every ruined detail hides a clue. Use your [b]items and wits[/b] to break through the darkness.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44512644/768aa8bf3e9e0850aac35ad065da3282f8fda1f4.png"][/img][/p][p][b]3. Heart-Pounding Encounters with Monsters[/b][/p][p]Each chapter introduces [b]new bosses and creatures[/b]. Fight or flee—[b]stealth kills[/b], [b]direct combat[/b], or [b]resourceful survival[/b]—the choice is yours.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44512644/4df1d6ba1b8c4610aaae2d971fc97aa7bd8debdf.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Welcome... to the nightmare of "the final breath"[/b][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: "The final breath" v0.2.14 version update announcement
notes.content:
Thank you for your support of The final breath! The game demo is constantly being optimized!
The contents of this v0.2.14 update are as follows:

(1) Added a story guide at the beginning of the game
(2) Removed the QTE mini-game in stealth
(3) Changed the effect of the tambourine prop to increase stamina by 20%, but increase the lung capacity consumption rate by 20%
(4) Modified the effect of sanity value (San): the spirometry consumption rate is increased by 20% when the san value is below zero.
(5) Backpack compartment expansion
(6) Modified the monster collision mechanism

We will continue to optimize the game, welcome everyone to join the official QQ group: 823261092 continue to give us feedback on any suggestions you have!

notes.title: Live of the prologue of the horror adventure puzzle game "The Final Breath".
notes.content:
The horror adventure puzzle game "The Final Breath" is live!
Welcome everyone to follow us at the New Product Festival! The prologue is now available for trial!
The content of this trial is open to the map Ah Yu's house, courtyard and rabbit apartment. The full exploration of the prologue lasts approximately one and a half hours. While feeling the horror atmosphere and style of the game, you can experience most of the gameplay including stealth & decryption > combat first!!

You play as a young boy named Ah Yu, who, on the eve of your 7th birthday, is torn apart by his mother's screams, when a low, seemingly otherworldly voice comes from outside the window, coldly guiding you to escape......

In the process of escaping, unknown horrors lurk in the darkness, whispers, shadows, and eerie laughter all the time to tear at your nerves...

In order to survive, you must rely on every prop in your hands to uncover the veil of truth

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44512644/140dcede70aa6c9c8e641ce408f68e0acbacded5.jpg[/img]

notes.title: The Final Breath is about to participate in the Steam Next Fest!
notes.content:
Good afternoon, everyone! We're excited to announce that The final Breath is coming to the Steam Next Fest!
   The content of this trial includes the content of the prologue of the game, and the open map Ayu's house, courtyard and rabbit apartment, including nearly thirty intricate rooms.
The prologue is about 1 and a half hours long, and while feeling the horror atmosphere and style of the game, you can experience most of the gameplay including stealth & decryption & combat!!

While exploring the map and uncovering the truth, face all kinds of weird monsters...

Will you be able to overcome the odds and find your way out of your apartment?

Amid the flickering images accompanied by the sound of thunder and lightning, there is a sharp knock at the door, and your adventure has just begun.

We welcome all players to give us feedback on what they think of the game. You can face the developer directly on the game's official community, and we will reply as soon as possible. Any suggestions you have are very important to us.
Finally, if you like "The Final Breath ", please be sure to add a wishlist to support us! Thank you for trying the game!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44512644/0845787802b108c8bbc76e032073da90eee5c327.jpg[/img]
